core.name: Mighty Molten Edge
core.text:
Gains 0.1 Sheer Force per point of Max HP; all his Fire DMG is Sheer DMG, ignoring DEF.
Sacrifice and Defensive Assists build Blazing Heart (max 100). At 75 he enters Molten Edge, draining 3.3 per second until empty: his Basic Attacks are enhanced, he can use Return to Ashes - Fall, and he gets +10% CRIT Rate and +{1}% Fire DMG.
Misty Slash and Breaking Fang hits that cost HP get +{0}% CRIT DMG and double Adrenaline generation.

ability.name: Rekindled Heart
ability.text: Ultimate gives 8 Remnant Flame and Chain Attack 4 (max 20, 60s). Below full HP, Misty Slash and Breaking Fang hits spend 1 to heal 2% Max HP.
